activity_workflow_check.name: activity_workflow_check
activity_workflow_check.value: "crm_activities"."type" in ('task','call','meeting','email','note') and "crm_activities"."status" in ('open','completed','cancelled') and "crm_activities"."priority" in ('low','normal','high') and (("crm_activities"."status" = 'completed' and "crm_activities"."completed_at" is not null and length(trim("crm_activities"."outcome")) > 0) or ("crm_activities"."status" <> 'completed' and "crm_activities"."completed_at" is null))

lead_workflow_check.name: lead_workflow_check
lead_workflow_check.value: "crm_leads"."status" in ('new','working','qualified','disqualified','converted') and "crm_leads"."score" between 0 and 100 and (("crm_leads"."converted_at" is null and "crm_leads"."status" <> 'converted' and "crm_leads"."converted_contact_id" is null and "crm_leads"."converted_company_id" is null and "crm_leads"."converted_deal_id" is null and "crm_leads"."converted_by" is null) or ("crm_leads"."converted_at" is not null and "crm_leads"."status" = 'converted' and "crm_leads"."converted_contact_id" is not null and "crm_leads"."converted_by" is not null))
